Body.description: An institution: a legislature, a chamber, a ministry, a court, a regional organ.
Body.title: Body

Dated.description: A date as normalised (ISO 8601) and as printed, in the calendar it was printed in.
Dated.title: Dated

Event.description: One step in the document's life, dated, with who acted and on which part.
Event.title: Event

Evidence.description: Where a detail was read or who supplied it.
Evidence.title: Evidence

ExecutiveProfile.description: Decrees, executive and ministerial orders made under the constitution or a law.
ExecutiveProfile.title: ExecutiveProfile

Expression.description: A language version of the document, and what its text is worth as law where that is recorded.
Expression.title: Expression

JudgmentProfile.description: Judgments, rulings, orders and opinions of courts and tribunals, national and regional.
JudgmentProfile.title: JudgmentProfile

LanguageRule.description:
The instrument's own rule for divergence between its language versions, where it states one: the
OHADA Treaty (art. 42) has documents take effect in French before translation and the French version
prevail where versions differ. ``prevails`` is the language whose version prevails, when the rule
names one; a rule making every version equally authentic names none.
LanguageRule.title: LanguageRule

LegislationProfile.description: Constitutions and their amendments, and primary legislation.
LegislationProfile.title: LegislationProfile

OtherProfile.description: Soft law, parliamentary records and other official documents.
OtherProfile.title: OtherProfile

Person.description: Someone acting in a document as printed: a signatory, a judge, a sponsor.
Person.title: Person

Reference.description: Another document: its work URI when known, and how it is cited.
Reference.title: Reference

RegionalProfile.description: Instruments of regional communities: ECOWAS, EAC, SADC, OHADA, UEMOA, CEMAC and others.
RegionalProfile.title: RegionalProfile

SubsidiaryProfile.description: Instruments made under the authority of another law.
SubsidiaryProfile.title: SubsidiaryProfile
